persistence_boundary: Run receipt persistence is asserted through task-scoped events with run_id and final outcome. Raw SQLite snapshots support diagnosis; no new run table or schema is required.
coverage: Automatic explicit submit -> independent oracle -> actual Git integration -> own pane reclaimed
Done with a real unsubmitted candidate cannot become success
Concurrent same-task run has one prompt/attempt; second run_busy
Nonpositive and noninteger waits leave business state, bindings, Git and resources unchanged
Old run frozen during observation cannot process or close a separately dispatched replacement
Bad candidate causes real oracle rejection and preserves Git history
Startup/post-prompt blocked or changed terminal identity retain scene, with no answer or retry
Matching, stale and accepted-idempotent verify/integrate attempt guards
Historical reclaim cannot revoke replacement; repeat, foreign and unknown attempt checks
Attempt guards retain the existing live operation lock
